name: Weather+
author: chrisvb
description: The stock weather widget plus optional modules you switch on: rain radar, weather warnings, air & pollen, sun & moon, tides, swell and Munich's Eisbach.

barWidget.description: Weather with optional rain radar, warnings, air & pollen, sun & moon, tides, swell and Eisbach.

schema.label: Units
schema.description: auto follows your locale and the location's country.

schema.label: Weather warnings
schema.description: Official DWD warnings for your location (Germany only).

schema.label: Rain radar
schema.description: When rain starts or stops in the next two hours.

schema.label: Air & pollen
schema.description: European air quality index, UV and the strongest pollen (Europe).

schema.label: Sun & moon
schema.description: Sunrise, sunset, golden hour, daylight gained and the moon phase.

schema.label: Tides
schema.description: Next high and low tide with a curve, at your coast spot.

schema.label: Swell
schema.description: Swell, sea temperature and wind at your coast spot.

schema.label: Eisbach
schema.description: Water temperature and flow of Munich's Eisbach.

schema.label: Coast spot name
schema.description: For tides and swell. Easier to set from the panel: open it and click Modules.

schema.label: In the bar
schema.description: A module's short reading next to the weather icon, e.g. the next tide or rain countdown.
